bark.work.drove: Hup, hup! Come on, you daft beasts.
Hey! Not into the corn, you!
Steady now, steady. Nobody's chasing you.
Go on, go on, the grass won't come to you.

bark.work.drove.text: Every morning the same: the gate, the lane, the long hill.
Home now, home. Your pens are waiting.
Wet wool and wet feet. Lovely.
Come on, you lot. Up to the high pasture.
Mind the bog, mind the bog!
To the water first, then the grazing.
Hep! Hep! Stay off the scree.

bark.work.herder: There's good grass up here. They know it.
Count them twice, a wolf only needs one.
Not a cloud. Not a care. That's the life.
You there, stop pushing the ewe.
The dog does the real work. I just carry the stick.

bark.work.herder.text: Wind's in the east. They'll huddle tonight.
They'll be fat for the market, this lot.
Another hour and we turn for home.
A goat will eat anything. Even your hat.

bark.work.clamp: Don't let her flare. Two days she must smoulder.
Too much air and it's ash. Too little and it's wood.
Smell that? That's a good burn.
Mind the vents. Don't you dare poke them.
Charcoal for the smith, and not a log wasted.
I sleep by her. She needs watching.
Earth on, turf on, and pray.

bark.work.clamp.text: Rain on the turf is good. Rain in the vents is not.
The wood talks to you if you listen. Hear it hiss?
Stack them tight, billets on end. Like this.
Black to the elbows by the end of the day.

bark.work.miner: Lamp lit? Good. Down we go.
The old men dug deep. We dig deeper.
Two hundred rungs. I count every one.
Listen to the rock. When it creaks, you run.
There's iron in this mountain yet.
Mind your head on the props.

bark.work.miner.text: Up the track before the birds are awake.
Home to the light, and supper.
Wet up there? Dry as bones down here.
Somebody left a pick down on the third level. Again.

bark.work.fisher: Quiet now, you'll scare them off.
The water's cold but the fish are good.
Out with the dawn, back with the bells.

bark.work.fisher.text: Rain makes them rise. Good for us.
Herring, cod, if the sea is kind.
A calm morning on the water. Nothing better.

bark.work.stall: Look at this {goods}, made right here in {settlement}.

bark.work.stall.text: Last {goods} of the day, half the haggling!
